Your own AI workspace
private, friendly, and easy

LiteMindUI lets you chat, ask questions about your own files, search the web, and even talk out loud with an AI that runs on your computer. Your data stays with you.

Get LiteMindUI For Developers →

What is LiteMindUI?

Think of it as a friendly helper that lives on your computer. You type or speak to it, and it answers, writes, and finds things for you, using either a smart AI model on your machine or one from the internet, your choice.

💬

Chat

Have a conversation. Ask questions, brainstorm ideas, or get help writing an email, a story, or a plan.

📄

Ask your documents

Drop in your PDFs, notes, or reports and ask questions about them. Ask "What did we decide in the meeting notes?" and it will tell you.

🌐

Search the web

Let it look things up online and bring back a clear, sourced answer instead of a wall of links.

🎙️

Talk out loud

Turn on voice mode and just speak. It listens, thinks, and replies with a natural voice, like a phone call with your assistant.

Why people choose LiteMindUI

It is built to be calm, capable, and respectful of your privacy.

🔒

Private by design

Your files and conversations can stay entirely on your own computer. Nothing leaves your machine unless you choose to use a cloud service.

🖥️

Works offline

With a local AI model, LiteMindUI keeps working even without the internet. No connection? No problem.

🤝

Friendly for everyone

You do not need to be a programmer. If you can open a web page, you can use it.

🌱

Open source

The code is free and open for anyone to read, improve, and trust. No lock-in, no surprises.

How do I get started?

Three simple steps. The details live in the project README, and here is the friendly version.

Get a copy

Download or clone the project from GitHub to your computer. It is free.

Run it

One command starts everything (Docker does the heavy lifting). No manual setup needed.

Open & chat

Open the address it shows you in your browser, and start talking to your AI. That's it.

Good to know: You can start with a small AI model that runs privately on your computer, or connect a more powerful cloud model later. Either way, you stay in control of your data.
